provenance: Ground truth derived from Kubernetes-Goat's intentionally vulnerable manifests, not tied to any single scanner. It contains two sub-classes, distinguished per item by 'source_class': (1) scenario-documented findings (GT-001-008) - misconfigurations narrated by a hand-written exploit scenario under guide/docs/scenarios and infrastructure/goat-home content; and (2) manifest-present findings (GT-009+) - static misconfigurations physically present in a vendored manifest and clearly scanner-flaggable, but not narrated by any exploit scenario. Attack techniques, image-embedded secrets, and defensive-tooling scenarios remain held out. Suitable as a cross-tool-neutral set.

items.resource_or_line: Deployment/system-monitor-deployment (hostPath volume path: / mounted at /host-system, L28-31 & L44-46)
items.notes: Host root filesystem mounted into the container via hostPath; intentional escape vector explicitly named in scenario 4 (Container escape to the host system).

items.resource_or_line: Role/secret-reader in namespace big-monolith (rules: resources ['*'], verbs get/watch/list, L7-15; bound to big-monolith-sa)
items.notes: Overly permissive RBAC Role granting read of all resources (incl. secrets) to a pod's ServiceAccount; intentional, documented in scenario 16 (RBAC least privileges misconfiguration).

items.resource_or_line: Deployment/hunger-check-deployment in namespace big-monolith (no resources.limits/requests set, L70-81)
items.notes: Container has no CPU/memory limits or requests, enabling resource-exhaustion DoS; intentional, documented in scenario 13 (DoS the Memory/CPU resources).
Service exposed cluster-wide via NodePort (the only NodePort in the repo); intentional, documented in scenario 8 (NodePort exposed services).

items.resource_or_line: ClusterRoleBinding/superadmin binds ServiceAccount superadmin (kube-system) to ClusterRole/cluster-admin (L7-18)
items.notes: ServiceAccount granted full cluster-admin via a ClusterRoleBinding - excessive privilege enabling total cluster control. Manifest-present and clearly scanner-flaggable, but not narrated by any exploit scenario.

items.resource_or_line: Deployment/health-check-deployment (securityContext.privileged=true on the health-check container L63-64; also on the init container L51-52)
items.notes: Privileged container(s) granting host-level access. Manifest-present and clearly scanner-flaggable, but not narrated by any exploit scenario.

items.resource_or_line: Deployment/health-check-deployment (hostPath volume docker-sock-volume-fallback path: /var/run/docker.sock, L95-98; mounted into the container L71)
items.notes: Host Docker socket mounted into the container via hostPath - grants container-escape/host-control capability. Manifest-present and clearly scanner-flaggable, but not narrated by any exploit scenario.
